name: passbox
description: 跨 Harness 协作插件：在上下文隔离、确定性 Git 证据采集、按需引导与双行实时状态面板下将工程任务委托给原生 Codex CLI。Cross-harness delegation to Codex with context isolation, deterministic Git evidence, selective steering, and a live bilingual status board.
author: Passbox Contributors
suggestedPrompts: 使用 /passbox 将此问题修复委托给 Codex 并在完成后独立验证 | Use /passbox to delegate this bugfix to Codex and verify independently
使用 /passbox 收集当前任务的最新证据增量 | Use /passbox to collect the latest evidence delta for the active task
使用 /passbox 基于已验证的上游不变量引导当前任务 | Use /passbox to steer the active task with verified upstream invariants
